menu.description.standard:
Clint can break these open for you for 25g.
(Hold Shift or click 'Crack All' to open stack)
config.instant-cracking.name: Instant Cracking
config.instant-cracking.tooltip: Skips the 2.7-second delay to crack geodes instantaneously.
config.show-crack-all-button.name: Show 'Crack All' Button
config.show-crack-all-button.tooltip: Displays a dedicated 'Crack All' button in Clint's geode menu.
config.bulk-batch-size.name: Bulk Batch Size
config.bulk-batch-size.tooltip: Maximum number of geodes to crack in a single batch (999 = full stack).
config.show-summary-toast.name: Show Summary Toast
config.show-summary-toast.tooltip: Displays a HUD notification summarizing cracked geodes.
config.instant-geode-crusher.name: Instant Geode Crusher
config.instant-geode-crusher.tooltip: Makes Geode Crusher machines on the farm process geodes immediately.
config.geode-crusher-requires-coal.name: Geode Crusher Requires Coal
config.geode-crusher-requires-coal.toolt: Whether Geode Crusher machines require 1 Coal to operate.
config.max-stack-size.name: Max Stack Size
config.max-stack-size.tooltip: The maximum stack size for stackable items.
config.enable-tackle-stacking.name: Enable Tackle Stacking
config.enable-tackle-stacking.tooltip: Allow fishing tackles/bobbers with matching durability to stack.
config.enable-trinket-stacking.name: Enable Trinket Stacking
config.enable-furniture-stacking.name: Enable Furniture Stacking
config.enable-furniture-stacking.tooltip: Allow furniture and decorations to stack.
config.enable-ring-stacking.name: Enable Ring Stacking
Allow matching clothing and hats to stack.
config.enable-boots-stacking.name: Enable Boots Stacking
config.section.hover-info: Hover Information & Timers (UI Info Suite 2 Style)
config.enable-crop-hover.name: Crop Grow Times & Info
config.enable-crop-hover.tooltip: Show days remaining to harvest, growth stage, water, and fertilizer when hovering over crops.
config.enable-machine-hover.name: Machine Processing Timers
config.enable-machine-hover.tooltip: Show processing time remaining, finish times, and output products when hovering over machines.
config.enable-tree-hover.name: Tree & Bush Maturation
config.enable-tree-hover.tooltip: Show maturation days, fruit count, and moss status when hovering over trees and bushes.
config.enable-animal-hover.name: Animal & Pet Info
config.enable-animal-hover.tooltip: Show daily petting status, friendship hearts, and produce readiness when hovering over animals.
config.show-water-and-fertilizer.name: Show Water & Fertilizer
config.show-water-and-fertilizer.tooltip: Display soil moisture and fertilizer details in crop tooltips.
config.show-item-icon-in-tooltip.name: Show Item Icons
config.show-item-icon-in-tooltip.tooltip: Display item sprite previews next to titles in hover tooltips.
config.show-exact-finish-time.name: Show Exact Finish Clock Time
config.show-exact-finish-time.tooltip: Display the estimated clock time (e.g. 4:20 PM) when machines finish processing.
config.show-item-sell-price-on-hover.nam: Show Item Sell Price on Hover
config.show-item-sell-price-on-hover.too: Display single and stack sell prices when hovering over items in menus.
config.show-bundle-need-on-hover.name: Show Bundle Needs on Hover
config.show-bundle-need-on-hover.tooltip: Display Community Center bundle requirements when hovering over items in menus.
config.show-museum-need-on-hover.name: Show Museum Donation on Hover
config.show-museum-need-on-hover.tooltip: Display Museum donation status when hovering over items in menus.
config.hover-hotkey.name: Hover Activation Hotkey
config.hover-hotkey.tooltip: Key to hold down to show hover tooltips. Set to 'None' to always show on hover.
config.enable-lookup-anything.name: Enable Lookup Anything
config.enable-lookup-anything.tooltip: Press the lookup key (default F1) over any target to open detailed information cards.
config.lookup-key.name: Keyboard Lookup Hotkey
config.lookup-key.tooltip: Keyboard key to press to open the lookup card (default: F1).
config.controller-lookup-key.name: Controller Lookup Hotkey
config.controller-lookup-key.tooltip: Controller button to press to open the lookup card (default: RightStick / R3).
config.show-gift-tastes.name: Show Gift Tastes
config.show-gift-tastes.tooltip: Display loved and liked gifts on NPC cards and item cards.
config.show-item-recipes.name: Show Item Recipes
config.show-item-recipes.tooltip: Display crafting and cooking recipes where the item is an ingredient.
config.show-bundle-and-museum-info.name: Show Bundles & Museum Info
config.show-bundle-and-museum-info.toolt: Display Community Center bundle needs and Museum donation status on items.
